title: Code and data for "The Zabusky–Kruskal experiment for the absolute Rosenau–Hyman equation"
description:
Numerical codes, exported data and analysis scripts of the article The Zabusky–Kruskal experiment for the absolute Rosenau–Hyman equation by F. R. Villatoro. The article follows a periodic cosine under the absolute Rosenau–Hyman equation and studies its returns, the zeros of the solution and the sensitivity of the computations for the exponent 9/4, with a fourth-order Padé scheme and Fourier–Galerkin truncations.

The archive contains the solvers, the campaigns, the exported data and the audits of the numerical study, together with the scripts that compute the quantities reported in the article from those data and generate its figures. The complete trajectories of the Padé runs remain on the Picasso supercomputer (SCBI, Universidad de Málaga).
notes: Funding: Universidad de Málaga, Spain, project PRO-B4-2026-011 of its Plan Propio de Investigación, Transferencia y Divulgación Científica. Computations were run on the Picasso supercomputer of the SCBI (Supercomputing and Bioinformatics Center) of the Universidad de Málaga.
